note: 0-based archive leaf indices for a 1611 King James first-edition copy (Robert Barker, London), from the Early English Books 1475-1640 collection. Verified by eye against the scan: n0 is the engraved title page (Cornelis Boel; 'THE HOLY BIBLE, Conteyning the Old Testament, AND THE NEW'), n2 is the dedication 'TO THE MOST HIGH AND MIGHTIE Prince, IAMES'. Replaced the earlier item 'the-holy-bible-1611', which archive.org withdrew from public access (is_dark) in Sep 2026, so its images returned HTTP 500. No verse text is served from this item; it is used solely for the front-matter plates on /printers.
